Name: Hyper Plumber Farming
Author: Pinheadius
Description:
[font=Courier New][size=4][u][center][b]Languages[/b][/center][/u]
[/size][/font]
[list=1]
[*]english
[*]german (is included)
[/list]

[size=4]
[/size][b][font=Courier New][size=4][center][u]Description[/u][/center]
[/size][/font][/b]
Adds 3 Mushrooms (so far) from the famous italian or bosnian plumber games (Also with german translation), optional with letter (then you will need
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]"Mail Framework Mod"[/url]﻿).



[font=Courier New][size=4][b][u][center]Farmable Mushrooms[/center][/u][/b][/size][/font]
[list]
[*]Hyper Mushroom
[*]Life Mushroom
[*]Poison Mushroom
[/list]
You can buy them from [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Marlon]"Marlon"[/url]﻿ at the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Adventurer%27s_Guild]"Adventurer's Guild"[/url]﻿, when you choose also the optional file "Hyper Plumber Farming Letters", then Marlon will send you a letter (on 28th of Spring Year 1) with 5 seeds of the Hyper Mushroom.

[u]

[/u][b][font=Courier New][size=4][center][u]Coming soon
[/u][/center][/size][/font][/b]Hyper Plumber Hats! See Screenshot in the description.



[b][u][font=Courier New][size=4][center]Future Plans[/center][/size][/font][/u][/b]
I'll try to keep updating, want to add Mushroom Hats, more crops (Flame Flower, Super Star, ect. and also like a letter questline with letters from princess shroom-chair.)
I will never add "Coins" because i couldn't make coin crops better than [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/26612284]paradigmnomad[/url] in his awesome [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1610]"Fantasy Crops"[/url]﻿ mod, i have an idea that you can craft the "?" and "!" boxes, i'll make it compatible with  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1610]"Fantasy Crops"[/url]﻿, that you can or have to use these coins for the recipe, but that's all future plans.

Enjoy.



[b][u][font=Courier New][size=4][center]Installation[/center][/size][/font][/u][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/index.php?title=Modding:SMAPI_compatibility&oldid=74245#Json_Assets]Json Assets 1.2+[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod (Hyper Plumber Farming) and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b][u][font=Courier New][size=4][center]Installation with letters[/center][/size][/font][/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/index.php?title=Modding:SMAPI_compatibility&oldid=74245#Json_Assets]Json Assets 1.2+[/url]﻿.
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]

[*]Download this mod (Hyper Plumber Farming Letters) and obviously "Hyper Plumber Farming", then unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
